method_map.assertions: Accept an exact Graph input port with an OutputRef source; reject a changed port name.
Read the new current revision after replacement through either held code owner. Reject wrong scope and revoked Inspect.
method_map.contract_translation: Read current Data status and exact saved history through fresh Inspect. A held immutable program is not a mutable active-export cache.

method_map.assertions: Reject missing, unknown and wrongly typed arguments before any execution result or current state. Accept two valid selected exports.
method_map.contract_translation: Image installation is inert. Typed SQL named arguments are validated when the selected definition is admitted. There is no global JSON parameter namespace or implicit activation of every export.

method_map.assertions: Explicit renewal changes the grant while Failed readiness, progress, checkpoint and saved output stay exact.
Retain unsupported code metadata; reject execution of an unsupported selected dependency; repeat storage without effects.
method_map.contract_translation: Unsupported images remain inert metadata. A selected native call must have a supported implementation. Installation does not create dependency activations or a MissingInput status row.

method_map.assertions: Separate roots keep separate arguments and state; changed arguments require explicit rebuild for state reuse.
method_map.contract_translation: Independent Instances and call identities replace the shared global parameter activation. Shared immutable code does not imply shared arguments, grant or checkpoint.

method_map.assertions: The old fixed MAX_PACKAGE_METADATA_BYTES rejection is abolished.
method_map.contract_translation: The user removed package count, text, row, byte and checkpoint caps. Keep schema validity and shared engine operational capacity at their current owners. Do not add a replacement package ceiling.

method_map.assertions: A failed candidate preserves current generation, progress and prior output before and after reopen.
method_map.contract_translation: An explicitly installed image and a durable candidate can remain after failure. Current generation changes only on atomic successful version publication.

method_map.assertions: Keep every live or inactive durable image reference; collect unreferenced code and leave repeat collection inert.
method_map.contract_translation: Explicit guarded uninstall and reference-aware collection replace startup activation-registry cleanup. The old 33 orphan activation records are not objects in the native model. Constructor admission starts no work.

method_map.assertions: Return exact original descriptor, revision and value; retain only selected executable code; reject unsupported selected export and revoked execution.
method_map.contract_translation: One admitted native definition owns its complete immutable image. It does not scan or admit unrelated active grants. Exact callback counts from that scan are obsolete.

method_map.assertions: Share exact immutable image ownership across selected calls and clones, retain complete descriptor and per-call arguments, reject another tenant, preserve read-only historical replay, and recheck current authority.
method_map.contract_translation: Current source execution still captures through Data. Occupying all legacy Data readers is not a requirement to execute current source queries without a reader. Saved replay uses saved inputs and has no publication sink.

method_map.assertions: The final prepared owner or clone drop releases image, code, metadata and shared capacity.
Retained call output keeps original descriptor, revision, target, context and parameters; borrowed arrays remain charged until the last buffer drops.
Guest trap and cancellation release execution permits and temporary input/output capacity after joined cleanup; later valid work succeeds.
Exact old and current images remain distinct; retained old replay keeps its original code and cannot publish; current scope and authority still apply.
method_map.contract_translation: Admitted exact images survive uninstall while a durable definition refers to them. The old requirement that removal prevents all old-image repinning is superseded by retained read-only history.

method_map.assertions: All actual retained images and current execution authority are checked atomically before an effect; a later failed call leaves the prior state intact.
method_map.contract_translation: Independent grants use independent Instances. A mixed-grant global active-export registry and its exact callback count are absent.

method_map.assertions: Removal and publication have one durable order; joined removal fences old owners and preserves original result history.
method_map.contract_translation: The Data transaction and worker join replace the process-local legacy lifecycle mutex.

method_map.assertions: Explicit collection cannot remove a live admitted image closure; a released exclusive closure can be collected.
method_map.contract_translation: Constructing a Host does not perform legacy admission cleanup. No constructor lock or automatic registry collection is required.

method_map.assertions: Renewal uses exact lifecycle CAS, preserves prior state, and prevents stale capture or publication.
method_map.contract_translation: Run does not implicitly renew the stored grant. Explicit stopped renewal replaces the old Run-triggered renewal.

method_map.assertions: Publication and suspension have one order; old generation/lifecycle cannot commit after authority suspension.
Reject dependency cycles, changed input schema and conflicting immutable package revisions without partial image rows or activation.
Installing domain-kind code produces no automatic domain result. Domain publication requires the destination-specific conversion and atomic Data path.
method_map.contract_translation: Generic SQL calls compute Arrow values. Model kind metadata is not a domain publication authority. The old install-time Unsupported status is replaced by inert image installation and explicit Graph or Discovery publication owners.

method_map.assertions: Removal and narrower recreation do not widen access to old scope; whole-scope fresh Inspect can read the exact original result.
An exact retry returns the original receipt without new Data writes; changed request or version conflicts; old revision output remains readable after update and reopen.
Grant expiry and inherited caller cancellation prevent effects and release held execution resources; current revoked authority suspends a running member.
method_map.contract_translation: There is no fixed four-operation package semaphore. Existing Query and Runtime shared capacity owners supply operational limits.

method_map.assertions: A no-longer-current source proof makes retained output noncurrent. Inspection preserves the original packet, context, commit and successful progress; unavailable source capture cannot create an initial output.
method_map.contract_translation: Native Inspect is read-only. It derives currentness from saved source and deadline facts. It does not mutate stale rows, suspend dependency activations, or insert a fabricated downstream output.

method_map.assertions: Foreign tenant and revoked current grants reject capture or disclosure without output/progress changes or retained capacity leaks.
A declared input can refer to a later declared input, including an empty relation. Keep original input order, exact schema, revisions, coverage, dependency identity and immutable retry across reopen.
method_map.contract_translation: Native named input plans replace activation ordering. SQL input revision and captured dependency references remain exact.

method_map.assertions: Retained output aliases share Arrow buffers, exact result identity and scoped metadata while held buffers remain charged. Released owners return shared capacity.
method_map.contract_translation: There is no per-model input budget. Reuse stays within the captured native source and memory owners.

method_map.assertions: Alias inputs retain exact rows, revisions, coverage, witnesses and contexts, including empty selected relations and catalog inputs. Shared engine pressure remains typed and releases on cleanup.
method_map.contract_translation: The old per-model byte-limit matrix is abolished. Two aliases of one immutable result share actual buffer ownership. SQL controls selected row count; existing shared engine capacity is separate.

method_map.assertions: An oversized invocation must fail the configured engine input budget without guest entry or state effects; the old fixture also expects this error before corrupt component compilation.
method_map.contract_translation: Current native preparation compiles selected guest code before execution. The engine input-budget and no-guest-entry assertions remain. Exact pre-compilation error precedence is not established by these tests; the withdrawn SDK max_rows proposal is not proof that this engine-bound assertion is abolished.

method_map.assertions: Trap, runtime host-call failure, declared guest Limit and invalid evidence produce the correct failure class, no successful output, saved Failed readiness and no progress; reopen preserves failure and permits a new request.
method_map.contract_translation: Install is inert; failures occur on explicit execution. Known terminal request IDs conflict on retry; a fresh request can run the same failing code after reopen. This replaces install-time execution and old implicit retry.

method_map.assertions: Duplicate execution implementations reject atomically before any code admission or activation.
Stop stays responsive while admission is held; shutdown waits for the real worker, retains resources until join, then leaves prior state exact.
Cancelled diagnostic persistence cannot overwrite current output/progress or fabricate a durable terminal outcome.
Cancel or revoke at the real commit boundary prevents publication and joins held work; prior checkpoint/result remains exact and later valid work can proceed.

Operational pressure retains the prior output, currentness facts, and successful progress; no false failure or partial result is saved; resources release and supported work resumes from the same capture.
method_map.contract_translation: Managed attempt ownership keeps the exact admitted capture under pressure. It does not silently replace a pending finite attempt with a fresh input cut.

method_map.assertions: Remove an Instance while preserving exact history; collect exclusive code only after its durable references release.
Removing one Instance keeps another independent Instance and retained shared code; uninstall does not invalidate admitted code.
method_map.contract_translation: There is no shared activation rehome or mixed-grant dependency owner.

method_map.assertions: An explicitly installed image root remains a durable reference after removing its consumer.
Uninstall and collection release unused exclusive artifacts, preserve other tenant references, and repeat without writes.
Immutable definitions and current version changes do not leave mutable dependency activation orphans; collect unreferenced code while retaining exact historical images.
method_map.contract_translation: There is no obsolete shared activation to reconcile. Durable definition and retained result references control collection.

contract_translations: Image and first Instance admission are inert; explicit execution owns results.
Independent grants and call sites own independent Instance state. No global active-export registry is added.
Run does not renew or change stored execution attribution. Explicit stopped renewal changes the grant.
Historical disclosure uses fresh Inspect and captured exact scope; retained images survive uninstall while durable references exist.
Native SQL selects rows. SDK package quotas and fixed metadata caps are abolished. Existing shared engine and Runtime operational controls remain separate.
Inspect derives currentness without old stale-row mutations. Native Query subscriptions supply relevant source and window events; no recurring source or clock polling is restored.

The user approved current-scope callers to control an existing Instance. Normal operations keep saved execution identity. Explicit stopped, joined, exact-selection Renew replaces the grant. No sharing policy or authority adapter is added.
Native Query source/window events replace old autonomous scalar/model polling. Clock-only idle is an intended native contract; no recurring clock watcher is required.
Cold Host renewal compares exact resolved pins and canonical image archives. Allocation address identity applies only to the removed in-memory clone route.
public349 passes renewal; its new source-window fixture fails before Query due to an invalid test batch and is not qualification for source recovery.
remaining: Source-window recovery, Discovery native selection and window recovery, and Graph qualification remain open. No production Back owner is removed in this change.
verification_scope: Focused checks only, as required by the user. Failed and interrupted runs remain in the archive.
